greet.text: The gate remembers faces better than names. Yours is familiar and I cannot place it, which is the worst of both.

choices.unavailableNote: Hannu does not know your face well enough to ask you for a favor.
You have no seal to show him, and he has already looked at your hands.

again.text: "Second hour. You know where the shadow is." He turns the board a little so you cannot read it. "Or have you come to tell me you have forgotten?"

choices.unavailableNote: Hannu does not know your face well enough to ask you for a favor.

after-answered.text:
He does not mention the tablet.

"You went to the shadow and I was not there. You did as you were told, which is not the same as being trusted."

choices.text: Ask whether the errand is finished.

after-burned.text:
He does not mention the tablet either. He looks at your hands, then at the gate, and writes nothing.

"You smell of smoke. The gate keeps its own accounts."

wants.text:
"A man who can carry a thing from one gate to another without opening it."

He wets the stylus at last. "That is all I will say at this gate."

finished.text:
"It was finished before you went."

He says it without apology, and goes back to the board.

errand.text: "Not here." He does not look up. "Come back at the second hour and stand where the wall is in shadow. If I am not there, I was never asked."

passing.text: "Everyone is passing. Some of them are passing through my ledger."
